title: EntityDefIr
description: A Bedrock entity definition: a data-driven entity-component system with 120 components, 171 AI goals, component groups mutated at runtime by events, and typed properties. SC-160. Registration is SC-120 section 5.

runtimeIdentifier.description: Masquerade as a vanilla Bedrock entity to inherit hardcoded client behaviour. No Java analogue; likely wontfix with a small allowlist (SC-160 section 2).

spawnCategory.description: Selects which registered EntityType the entity uses, because MobCategory is baked into EntityType and cannot be dynamic (SC-120 section 5.2).

classFamily.description: Inferred from the component set: which Java base class family this needs. Fixed at spawn time for a given individual.

properties.description: Typed entity properties, queryable as q.property() and settable by events. Synced over the sideband, never SynchedEntityData (constitution rule 6).

components.description: The base component set. Keys are Bedrock component names.

componentGroups.description: Named component sets that events add and remove at runtime. The mechanism with no Java analogue at all — adding or removing one rebuilds the GoalSelector at a tick boundary.

vanillaFallback.description: Wire carrier entity type. SC-270 section 4.

values.description: Enum members. Geyser caps these at 16 with 32-character names (SC-210 section 4).

clientSync.description: Whether the client needs this. Only synced properties cost bandwidth.

event.description: A declarative mutation of the component-group set. Application order, re-entrancy and the recursion bound are TODO(SC-160) — Bedrock's behaviour there is undocumented and needs observation.

randomize.description: Weighted choice. Weights normalise at parse time; a zero total is SCE-2030 and the first entry is taken.

chance.description: Bedrock's %50 suffix syntax, normalised to a 0..1 probability. 1 when absent.
